title: 霸王龙的牙齿
subtitle: 一辈子换个不停
character: wearing a rust orange t-shirt, dark teal shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, bold flat graphic art with thick clean outlines and flat fills, deep teal, rust orange and cream

pages.zh:
玻璃柜里放着一颗牙。
它比我的手掌还长，
边上还有
一排小锯齿。
爸爸说那是霸王龙的。
pages.scene: The little boy looks through a museum glass case at one huge dinosaur tooth on a stand, leaning close, curious.

pages.zh:
这颗牙有多大呢？
和香蕉差不多长。
露在牙床外面的
只是上面一小截，
底下还埋着一大半。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one large pointed tooth shape and one banana shape lying side by side on a cream background, exactly the same length. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
牙的边上有锯齿，
和面包刀一样。
这样咬下去，
不是切断，
是撕开。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one tooth edge shown large on a cream background with small even saw teeth along it, and one bread knife below it with the same saw edge. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
牙断了怎么办？
不要紧。
下面早就长好了新的，
顶上来接着用，
一辈子换个不停。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one jaw cut open on a cream background showing one tooth standing in place and one new tooth growing underneath it, with an arrow pointing up. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
它咬得有多狠？
一口下去，
骨头都能咬碎。
骨头碎了，
里面的骨髓也吃得到。
pages.scene: One large meat-eating dinosaur head biting down on a big bone on a cream background. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我们咬东西的力气，
和它一比
差得太远了。
它咬一口的力气，
抵得上好几十个大人。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two horizontal bars on a cream background starting from the same left edge, the top bar very short and the bottom bar running almost the whole width. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
它的头很大，
头骨上却有好多空洞。
这样又轻又结实，
咬下去的时候
才不会把自己震坏。
pages.scene: One large dinosaur skull seen from the side on a cream background, with several big openings in the bone. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
它的前爪特别小，
小到摸不到自己的嘴。
可它力气不小，
能牢牢钩住东西
不让跑掉。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one meat-eating dinosaur silhouette on a cream background with a circle drawn around its two very short front arms. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
它的鼻子很灵。
风一吹过来，
很远的地方
有什么东西死掉了，
它就闻得到。
pages.scene: One meat-eating dinosaur standing with its head raised and nose lifted into the wind on a cream background. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
它吃活的，
也吃死的。
碰上现成的，
就不用自己去追，
省好多力气。
pages.scene: One meat-eating dinosaur walking towards a big bone lying on the ground on a cream background. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
掉下来的牙
埋进泥沙里，
过了很久很久，
慢慢变成石头。
我们今天才捡得到。
pages.scene: One large tooth lying half buried in layered ground on a cream background. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我把手贴在玻璃上，
和那颗牙比一比。
它一颗牙，
就有我半只手
那么长。
pages.scene: The little boy presses his open hand flat against the museum glass beside the big tooth, comparing them, smiling.
